text:
Type: striped rectangular lumbar cushion
Use: back support and a color accent on a sofa, armchair or bench; living room, bedroom, sunroom
Style: contemporary, coastal, retro
Materials: woven cotton-blend fabric with printed stripes
Colors: teal blue, sky blue, olive green, charcoal black, light grey, white
Shape: long rectangle with narrow vertical stripes of varied widths, flat seamed edges, softly filled, compact
Feel: lively, fresh, casual, cool
Goes with: grey or white sofas, light wood, rattan, blue or green accents; coastal, contemporary or Scandinavian rooms
